Reposition the front suspension lower track control arm.

Tighten the bolts fixing the suspension to the crossmember.

The bolts fixing the track control arm should be tightened to torque keeping the arm in the theoretical load position. The wheels will therefore have to be fitted on the vehicle which should be on the ground or on a lift.

Place the vehicle in standard 'A' conditions, i.e. with the spare wheel, tool kit, all fluids and a full tank of fuel. Check that the tyre pressures are correct.
